note: Production model = v8 final (no held-out year, trained on the entire 2017-2026 dataset, 2384 samples). Promoted to production after blind-testing on 2015 (242 samples, genuinely never trained on) and 2016 (244 samples, genuinely never trained on) -- both years profitable and reasonably calibrated (bias close to 1.0), though prediction accuracy (R2) is weaker the further back from the training window. See blind_test_results below. Model files are physically named model_v8_foldfinal_{mfe,mae}.pkl / scaler_v8_foldfinal_{mfe,mae}.pkl (copied from model_v8_final_*.pkl to fit MLPredictionAgent's existing fold{N} loading convention -- no code change needed). Targets are ATR-normalized (mfe_target/atr_14, mae_target/atr_14); predictions are converted back to points via * atr_14 at inference time (see ml_prediction_agent.py norm_target handling).
optimal_rr_threshold_source: Carried over from the walk-forward S4 baseline threshold (not independently re-tuned for v8_final specifically) -- 2015+2016 blind-test sample size (486 rows combined) was judged too small for a robust dedicated grid search.

in_sample_reference.note: 2017-2026 in-sample Scenario 4/5 (model already trained on this data -- optimistic, not a validity claim, kept for reference only)

previous_model: regression_v8_walk_forward_atr_normalized fold2026 (production_fold=2026, trained on 2017-2025, walk-forward validated) -- see summary_v8.json for its fold-by-fold metrics
